meta.title: Secure payment — Marg Darshan
meta.description: Pay securely for your consultation with Razorpay — UPI, GPay, PhonePe, net banking and cards.

securedNote: Your card and bank details never reach us.

hold.srMinutes: Your slot will be released in {minutes} minutes

expired.title: Your slot hold has expired
expired.body: Payment wasn't completed within 10 minutes, so the slot has been released. No worries — you can pick a time again.

alreadyPaid.title: This booking is already paid
alreadyPaid.body: Tap below to see the status of your booking.

closed.title: This booking is no longer active
closed.body: This booking was cancelled or completed. Tap below to make a new booking.

unavailable.title: Payment is unavailable right now
unavailable.body: We couldn't load your booking due to a technical issue. Please try again shortly or reach us on WhatsApp.

errors.generic: We couldn't start the payment. Please try again.
errors.notConfigured: Online payments aren't switched on yet. Please contact us on WhatsApp.
errors.sdk: Razorpay couldn't load. Check your connection and try again.
errors.failedGeneric: Payment failed. If money was debited, it will be returned automatically.
errors.signature: We couldn't verify the payment. Please contact us.
errors.dismissed: Payment window closed. You can try again.

status.checkingBody: Please keep this page open. This can take a few seconds.
status.successBody: A confirmation email with a calendar invite is on its way. We'll also remind you on WhatsApp before the session.
status.partialTitle: Advance received — your slot is reserved!
status.partialBody: A payment link for the balance of {balance} has been emailed to you.
status.failedBody: Your payment failed or was cancelled. If any amount was debited, it will be refunded automatically in 5–7 days.
status.pendingBody: The bank is taking a while to confirm. You'll get an email as soon as it succeeds — please don't pay again.
status.missingBody: This link looks incomplete or wrong. Please use the link from your email or message us on WhatsApp.
